einzeiler: Gracie Norton reflects on two years of podcasting and announces a move to YouTube.
kurzfassung: Gracie Norton looks back on two years of the Wellness Her Way podcast, sharing highlights from her guest interviews and personal wellness journey. She announces that she will be taking a break from the podcast to focus on creating long-form video content on YouTube. Finally, she outlines her essential starter pack tips for anyone looking to improve their health in the new year.
stichpunkte: Reflecting on two years of podcasting, community building, and overcoming early vulnerabilities
Sharing a year-end wrapped overview of favorite past episodes and recurring guests
Announcing a transition away from the audio podcast to focus entirely on YouTube video content
Emphasizing foundational wellness habits like blood work, balanced nutrition, and walking over extreme trends
Highlighting the importance of reducing refined sugar and prioritizing sleep and nervous system regulation
Discussing the value of strength training and intentional presence in daily life

kapitel.titel: Reflecting on Two Years of Podcasting
A Look Back at Favorite Episodes
The Wellness Her Way Starter Pack
Moving to YouTube and Final Goodbyes

clips.hook: Feeling too young for hormone issues?
clips.text: The host reflects on feeling self-conscious about experiencing hormonal problems in her early twenties when society expects young people to be in their physical prime.

clips.hook: Why internal health monitoring is essential
clips.text: A speaker notes that individuals invest tremendous effort into healthy habits, yet failing to monitor internal biomarkers means they could be overlooking the most critical piece.

clips.hook: Wellness should never feel like punishment
clips.text: The host argues that true health improvements come from finding sustainable daily habits that boost energy, sleep, and mood rather than enduring extreme restrictions.

clips.hook: Keeping stress reduction simple and realistic
clips.text: The speaker points out that trying to adopt overly complicated de-stressing practices defeats the purpose because nothing relaxing feels like an obligation.

beschreibung:
Episode 117: Hi guys!!! I can’t believe I’m saying that this is the last episode of Wellness Her Way for a bit. I’m pressing pause on the show and in this episode I explain what’s been on my heart lately. I took a trip down memory lane to recap how it all started and all of the amazing things this show has brought into my life. This has been on my heart for a while now and thus was one of the toughest- yet one of my favorite episodes I’ve recorded. I think I’ve been needing a different way to connect with you guys that will still bring you just as much value- so we will still be spending time together on a weekly basis, just on Youtube instead. I can’t wait to cook together, meal prep, workout, and just live daily life together. This is a change I feel like you guys are going to love to! So it’s not goodbye- just carrying everything over to Youtube so I can give you visuals for all the habits/ things I discuss on the podcast. I’m so excited for this next chapter and am beyond grateful for all of you. Until next time!
